# mistershell_motd (Resource)

Manages a MisterShell motd.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mistershell_motd" "example" {
  title      = "Maintenance notice"
  content    = "Scheduled maintenance is planned for Sunday."
  icon       = "info"
  is_enabled = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) Article content (Markdown/HTML)
- `title` (String) Article title

### Optional

- `icon` (String) Material icon name
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether to display this article

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Created at.
- `id` (String) Object identity. Import using this ID; resource variables use resource_id:stack_id.
- `order` (Number) Order.
- `updated_at` (String) Updated at.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mistershell_motd.example 123
```
